CVE-2011-3402.n: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2011-3402.act: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
CVE-2011-3402.d: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability in the TrueType font parsing engine in win32k.sys in the kernel-mode drivers that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted font data in a Word document or web page.

CVE-2011-4723.n: D-Link DIR-300 Router Cleartext Storage of a Password Vulnerability
CVE-2011-4723.act: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.
CVE-2011-4723.d: The D-Link DIR-300 router stores cleartext passwords, which allows context-dependent attackers to obtain sensitive information.

CVE-2011-1823.d: The vold volume manager daemon in Android kernel trusts messages from a PF_NETLINK socket, which allows an attacker to execute code and gain root privileges. This vulnerability is associated with GingerBreak and Exploit.AndroidOS.Lotoor.

CVE-2011-2462.n: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Universal 3D Memory Corruption Vulnerability
CVE-2011-2462.d: The Universal 3D (U3D) component in Adobe Reader and Acrobat contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

CVE-2011-0609.act: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.
CVE-2011-0609.d: Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

CVE-2011-2005.n: Microsoft Ancillary Function Driver (afd.sys) Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
CVE-2011-2005.d: afd.sys in the Ancillary Function Driver in Microsoft Windows does not properly validate user-mode input passed to kernel mode, which allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

CVE-2011-3544.n: Oracle Java SE Runtime Environment (JRE) Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2011-3544.d: An access control vulnerability exists in the Applet Rhino Script Engine component of Oracle's Java Runtime Environment allows an attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code.

CVE-2011-1889.n: Microsoft Forefront TMG Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2011-1889.d: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the Forefront Threat Management Gateway (TMG) Firewall Client Winsock provider that could allow code execution in the security context of the client application.

CVE-2011-0611.n: Adobe Flash Player Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2011-0611.act: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.
CVE-2011-0611.d: Adobe Flash Player contains a vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (application crash) via crafted Flash content.
